summary.text: Ryan Price is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 66 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Zach Payne. He works as a project manager.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Price advanced from the Democratic primary for District 66 on May 5, 2026, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as project manager.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a born-and-raised Hoosier, husband, father of two and community volunteer who has spent his professional career in the private sector.
He listed state budget and tax policy, public education funding, data center regulation and utility costs among his priorities.
